Cc: procure@kitewavelabs.com, ben.obbard@kitewavelabs.com
Date: Sun, 18 Feb 2029 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor security docs needed for PO approval

Hi David,

Hope you're well — Kitewave's procurement team is ready to move forward but needs a couple of items before they can raise a PO and route for internal approval: a fully executed DPA (or an executed copy), your latest SOC 2 report (Type 2 preferred), and a current subprocessor list with cloud-region/subprocessor roles called out.

Can you provide:
- Executed DPA (we can accept a signed PDF)
- A link to the SOC 2 Type 2 report or an access path to the attestation
- The subprocessor roster (CSV or PDF)
- Billing/contact info for PO (name, email, billing address, remit instructions)

Procurement is targeting a PO issuance by 2029-02-22 to meet our timelines. If you can get the documents over today or tomorrow that would keep us on track.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. If there's an internal team I should loop in, let me know.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Vendor Ops | Kitewave Labs
Samantha.Lee@kitewavelabs.com
Mobile: +1 415-555-0182

--

Thanks Samantha — and great to hear procurement is ready. Looping in Karthik (legal) and Laura (finance) to expedite.

We can provide everything you listed. Quick notes:
- I will attach the executed DPA and our current subprocessor export. Karthik, please confirm the DPA version attached is the fully executed copy we can share.
- Our SOC 2 Type 2 report is available via a secure link (shared below) — if Kitewave requires an NDA for the report access, tell us and we'll open a gated link.
- Laura, can you confirm the billing address and PO remittance instructions for Kitewave? Laura, do we require a minimum invoice lead time for first-month provisioning?

Samantha — can you confirm the PO contact (name/email) and the PO reference format you prefer (Kitewave internal PO#, or vendor-supplied reference)? That will help our billing team match the PO.

I'll send the attachments in a follow-up email (small files).

Best,
David Kim

- For billing email — please copy ap@redwood.com on any invoice submissions to speed matching.
